connection: stdlib sqlite3; every async request opens and closes its own connection
queries: Quiz detail fetches the quiz, then its questions, then the choices per question, so one query per question
transactions: answer submission writes answers in a single transaction with a commit at the end
n_plus_one: Yes: choices are fetched per question inside handle_quiz_detail
concurrency: asyncio handlers can interleave; each connection is used synchronously by one handler at a time

optimization_targets.description: Add a bounded connection pool so connections are reused across async requests
Add a batched choices lookup that resolves all questions of a quiz in one query
Use the pooled connections and the batched lookup while keeping the handlers async

notes: Quiz detail is fetched often during a live quiz; per-question choice queries can reach dozens per request, so batching matters.
